1.
 
The purpose of this memo is to give guidance to decision makers (DM) on The Social Security 
(Scotland) Act 2018 (Disability Assistance) (Consequential Amendments) Order 2024
1
. The amendments 
came into force on 21.10.24.

1 
SS (Scot) Act 2018 (Dis Ass) (CA) Order 2024
; 
SI 2024 No 919

2. This order
1
 
makes changes to social security legislation to reflect the introduction by the Scottish 
Government (SG) of the Pension Age Disability Payment (PADP). This is to replace Attendance 
Allowance (AA) for pension age adult’s resident in Scotland.
Claimant disabled and over State Pension Credit Age

3. 
G3030
 provides guidance on when a claimant is treated as having LCWRA where they have reached 
the qualifying age for State Pension Credit
1
. From 21.10.23 Entitlement to PADP is included in the list of 
qualifying benefits.
When the benefit cap does not apply

4. 
E5042
 provides guidance on when the BC does not apply when (a) a person is in receipt of a specified 
benefit, or (b) the person, or child or qualifying young person for whom they are responsible, is entitled to 
a specified benefit but it is not being received because of residence in a care home or hospital
1
. From 
21.10.24 PADP is included in the list of specified benefits.

5. 
F2182 et seq
 provides guidance on the occupation condition when a claimant is required to move 
home to accommodate home adaptations. From 21.10.24, PADP
1
 is added to the list of relevant benefits 
at F2183.

6. 
F3132
 gives guidance on when a renter in receipt of certain benefits satisfies the overnight care 
condition
1
. From 21.10.24, PADP is added to the list of relevant benefits.

7.
 F3136
 explains when a renter will be entitled to an additional bedroom if they satisfy the disabled 
person condition
1
. From 21.10.24 the disabled person condition is also satisfied where the renter is in 
receipt of PADP.

8. 
F3150-51
 gives guidance on when exemptions from HCC deductions apply
1
. From 21.10.24 included in 
this exemption are renters and their non-dependants (members of the renters benefit unit) where PADP 
is in payment.

1 
UC regs, Sch 4, para 15(2)(ca)
; 
Sch 4, para 16(2)(da)

9.
 
Recipients of NSJSA are not entitled to an award if they are engaged in a remunerative work. However, 
a claimant who is a carer
1
 (
see R2252
) for a recipient of a qualifying benefit, including PADP (added to the 
list of qualifying benefits with effect from 21.10.24), shall be exempt from this provision. See 
Chapter R2
 
(JSA conditions of entitlement) for further details.

1 
JSA Regs 13, reg 42(3)(c)(iii)
; 2
 
 
SS (Scot) Act 2018 (Dis Ass) (CA) Order 2024
NEW STYLE EMPLOYMENT AND SUPPORT ALLOWANCE

10. A period of disqualification from receiving ESA due to misconduct does not apply if the claimant 
qualifies as a “person in hardship.” 
U6038
 provides guidance on the circumstances under which a 
claimant or their partner may be considered a person in hardship, specifically if they have been awarded 
a specified benefit.

From 21.10.24, PADP will be added to the list of specified benefits
1
.

11. The definition of ‘Scottish Disability Benefit’ for revision and supersession purposes
1
 has been 
amended so that it now includes PADP. The consequences of this change are explained below.

1 
UC, PIP, JSA & ESA (D&A) Regs, reg 2

1.
 
The claimant has been awarded ESA, JSA, PIP or UC 
and

2.
 
The claimant or a member of the UC
 
family is awarded PADP 
and

3.
 
The first day of the award of PADP falls after the first day of the award of the ESA, JSA or UC

The award of ESA, JSA, PIP or UC can be revised
1
Superseding decisions on linked relevant benefits

1.
 
The claimant has been awarded PIP or UC 
and

2.
 
The claimant or a member of the UC family for benefit purposes becomes entitled to PADP or their 
PADP increases, decreases or ceases 
and

3.
 
This award, alteration or cessation of PADP is a relevant change of circumstances for PAP or UC 
purposes

The supersession for the change of circumstances takes effect from the date in [the next paragraph]
1
.

1.
 
Concerns UC, it takes effect from the first day of the AP in which

1.3
 
Entitlement to a different rate of PADP begins
1

2.
 
Concerns PIP, it takes effect from the date on which

2.3
 
Entitlement to a different rate of PADP begins
2

Arrears of benefit paid on or after date of death

15.
 
L3408
 gives guidance on arrears of benefit payable to the deceased not being counted as assets of 
the deceased when considering deductions from the amount of award of funeral payment. From 
21.10.24 arrears of PADP payable to the deceased as at the date of death are excluded from the assets 
of the deceased
1
 and included in the list of benefits excluded as assets of the deceased in
 
Appendix 1 to 
ADM Chapter L3
.
